title: Generator Fumes (Carbon Monoxide Poisoning)
immediate_warning: Move the person to fresh air immediately. Call 112. Do not re-enter the building alone.

immediate_warning_translations.en: Move the person to fresh air immediately. Call 112. Do not re-enter the building alone.

description: Carbon monoxide from generators is colourless and odourless. Running a generator indoors or in poorly ventilated spaces can kill within minutes.

description_translations.en: Carbon monoxide from generators is colourless and odourless. Running a generator indoors or in poorly ventilated spaces can kill within minutes.

steps.instruction: Move the person to fresh air IMMEDIATELY — outdoors or open all windows and doors.

instruction_translations.en: Move the person to fresh air IMMEDIATELY — outdoors or open all windows and doors.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Move the person to fresh air IMMEDIATELY — outdoors or open all windows and doors.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Move the person to fresh air IMMEDIATELY — outdoors or open all windows and doors.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Move the person to fresh air IMMEDIATELY — outdoors or open all windows and doors.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Move the person to fresh air IMMEDIATELY — outdoors or open all windows and doors.

steps.instruction: Call 112 or take to the nearest hospital at once.

instruction_translations.en: Call 112 or take to the nearest hospital at once.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call 112 or take to the nearest hospital at once.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call 112 or take to the nearest hospital at once.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call 112 or take to the nearest hospital at once.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call 112 or take to the nearest hospital at once.

steps.instruction: Turn off the generator if it is safe to do so.

instruction_translations.en: Turn off the generator if it is safe to do so.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Turn off the generator if it is safe to do so.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Turn off the generator if it is safe to do so.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Turn off the generator if it is safe to do so.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Turn off the generator if it is safe to do so.

steps.instruction: If unconscious, check for breathing. If not breathing, start CPR.

instruction_translations.en: If unconscious, check for breathing. If not breathing, start CPR.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If unconscious, check for breathing. If not breathing, start CPR.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If unconscious, check for breathing. If not breathing, start CPR.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If unconscious, check for breathing. If not breathing, start CPR.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If unconscious, check for breathing. If not breathing, start CPR.

steps.instruction: Place a conscious person in the recovery position on their side.

instruction_translations.en: Place a conscious person in the recovery position on their side.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Place a conscious person in the recovery position on their side.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Place a conscious person in the recovery position on their side.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Place a conscious person in the recovery position on their side.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Place a conscious person in the recovery position on their side.

steps.instruction: Keep the person warm and still until help arrives.

instruction_translations.en: Keep the person warm and still until help arrives.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person warm and still until help arrives.

instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person warm and still until help arrives.

do_not: Do not re-enter the building alone without fresh air.
Do not leave the person alone.
Do not run a generator inside any enclosed space — ever.
